title: FOOTAGE
description: A Body Camera / VHS DERCODE edit Based off of Derivative shaders
body:
A DERCODE Body Camera / VHS DERCODE fork Based off of Derivative shaders with tons of other realistic and cool effects, like shader grass, water simulation, GI etc.

Footage also has 100% physics mod (pro) support

proformance at 12 chunks:

gtx 1650 laptop ~100 fps
rtx 4070 laptop ~130 fps
rtx 3090        ~160 fps
amd 6700        ~120 fps

changelogs can be found on curseforge at 
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/project-1512050
